overrides.scope: The active Transformers.js integration is text-embedding only. It does not invoke image decoding, image preprocessing, or vision pipelines.
overrides.rationale: Transformers.js 3.8.1 remains pinned and declares sharp ^0.34.1. Sharp 0.35.5 fixes GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj plus the later libheif GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c and librsvg GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w advisories. Retain a narrowly validated text-embedding-only override rather than silently migrating the governed Transformers/ONNX runtime.

upstreamEvidence.migrationRationale: Transformers.js 4.3.2 adopts patched Sharp and ONNX 1.30.0, but this repository pins Transformers.js 3.8.1, its integrity, and the exact local model artifact and evaluation. A major runtime migration needs separate model/runtime validation. Retain Sharp 0.35.5 only within the existing AST-enforced feature-extraction and embedding-only boundary, with a fresh live benchmark against the unchanged pinned model.

overrides.scope: The override applies only to the ONNX Runtime installer dependency graph.
overrides.rationale: Pinned onnxruntime-node 1.21.0 declares tar ^7.0.1. Tar 7.5.22 is newer than the GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m affected <=7.5.20 range and remains within that declaration. Retain the exact patched installer resolution. Upstream ONNX 1.30.0 removes tar, but requires migration of the governed Transformers/ONNX runtime rather than an unvalidated transitive replacement.

overrides.scope: Development-only lint or watch-tool glob matching; not an application runtime dependency.
overrides.rationale: Minimatch <11.0.1 is affected by glob preprocessing amplification. This parent still declares major 10. Reviewed installed consumer sources use only the retained Minimatch constructor/match/pattern or minimatch function APIs, not removed makeRe/matchOne/regexp APIs. Retain this exact parent-specific override only while source hashes, dev-only lock graph, full lint and cross-platform glob integration tests remain valid.
